canonical_baseline.variant_policy: Regional, sectarian, and later literary traditions may be attached as variant records; they do not silently overwrite the core Valmiki-baseline record.

story_arcs.name: Ayodhya
story_arcs.focus: birth, family, succession, exile and duty

story_arcs.name: Mithila
story_arcs.focus: Sita, Janaka, bow ceremony and marriage

story_arcs.name: Forest Exile
story_arcs.focus: Dandaka, sages, rakshasas and moral trials

story_arcs.name: Kishkindha
story_arcs.focus: Rama-Sugriva alliance, Vali conflict and succession

story_arcs.name: Sita Search
story_arcs.focus: Hanuman, Angada, Jambavan, Sampati and the southern mission

story_arcs.name: Lanka
story_arcs.focus: Sita in Ashoka grove, Hanuman's mission and intelligence

story_arcs.name: Lanka War
story_arcs.focus: bridge, alliances, commanders, Indrajit, Kumbhakarna and Ravana

story_arcs.name: Return
story_arcs.focus: victory, return to Ayodhya and coronation

story_arcs.name: Uttara
story_arcs.focus: later kingship, Sita's later story and legacy

characters.name: Shri Ram
characters.identity_seed: Raghava; son of Dasharatha; Sita's husband; Lakshmana's elder brother
characters.visual_seed: royal-warrior bearing; disciplined athletic anatomy; bow-and-arrow identity; restrained divine presence

characters.name: Sita
characters.identity_seed: Janaki; Vaidehi; daughter of Janaka; wife of Rama
characters.visual_seed: graceful royal/forest identity; composed dignity; distinctive Mithila-Ayodhya costume evolution

characters.name: Lakshman
characters.identity_seed: Son of Sumitra; inseparable companion of Rama during exile
characters.visual_seed: lean athletic warrior; alert posture; bow-and-arrow; younger brother energy without modern styling

characters.name: Bharat
characters.identity_seed: Son of Kaikeyi; refuses to replace Rama and preserves Rama's authority
characters.visual_seed: royal Ayodhya prince; restrained grief and devotion; Paduka-centered visual motif

characters.name: Hanuman
characters.identity_seed: Rama's foremost devotee; son of Anjana in tradition; central agent of the search and Lanka mission
characters.visual_seed: powerful vanara anatomy; intelligent expressive face; gada identity; controlled supernatural strength

characters.name: Ravan
characters.identity_seed: Lanka king; scholar, warrior and powerful adversary; Sita's abductor
characters.visual_seed: mature commanding royal-warrior anatomy; crown and weapon identity; controlled multi-head representation when narratively required

characters.name: Vibhishan
characters.identity_seed: Ravana's younger brother who counsels against retaining Sita and joins Rama when rejected
characters.visual_seed: noble rakshasa royal; disciplined and composed; visually distinct from Ravana without breaking family resemblance

characters.name: Sugriva
characters.identity_seed: Exiled brother of Vali; restored to Kishkindha through Rama's alliance
characters.visual_seed: royal vanara physique; mature warrior-king; crown/ornament family distinct from Vali

characters.name: Vali
characters.identity_seed: Older brother of Sugriva; father of Angada; defeated by Rama
characters.visual_seed: exceptionally powerful vanara warrior; dominant musculature; kingly ornaments; distinct from Sugriva

characters.name: Meghanad / Indrajit
characters.identity_seed: Ravana's son and principal Lanka champion
characters.visual_seed: young-to-mature elite warrior; royal Lanka armor; supernatural weapon effects governed by canon

characters.name: Dasharath
characters.identity_seed: King of Ayodhya; father of Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna
characters.visual_seed: aged warrior-king; royal Ayodhya costume; emotionally expressive court presence

characters.name: Kaikeyi
characters.identity_seed: Queen of Dasharatha and mother of Bharata; invokes her boons leading to Rama's exile
characters.visual_seed: royal queen; martial heritage may inform bearing; visual arc from affection to political determination to remorse

characters.name: Shatrughna
characters.identity_seed: Youngest of Dasharatha's sons; closely aligned with Bharata
characters.visual_seed: young royal warrior; disciplined and understated

characters.name: Kaushalya
characters.identity_seed: Chief queen and mother of Rama
characters.visual_seed: mature royal matriarch; dignified maternal presence

characters.name: Sumitra
characters.identity_seed: Queen and mother of Lakshmana and Shatrughna
characters.visual_seed: calm royal matriarch; restrained strength

characters.name: Janak
characters.identity_seed: King of Mithila and father of Sita; central to the bow ceremony and marriage
characters.visual_seed: philosopher-king; refined Mithila royal costume; contemplative authority

characters.name: Urmila
characters.identity_seed: Daughter of Janaka; sister of Sita; wife of Lakshmana
characters.visual_seed: Mithila-Ayodhya royal identity; quiet emotional strength

characters.name: Mandavi
characters.identity_seed: Daughter of Kushadhvaja in the traditional genealogy; wife of Bharata
characters.visual_seed: Mithila-linked royal identity; composed palace presence

characters.name: Shrutakirti
characters.identity_seed: Sister of Sita and Urmila in the traditional Mithila family network; wife of Shatrughna
characters.visual_seed: Mithila-Ayodhya royal identity; understated presence

characters.name: Kumbhakarna
characters.identity_seed: Giant brother of Ravana; awakens for the Lanka war
characters.visual_seed: colossal rakshasa scale; massive warrior anatomy; Lanka armor

characters.name: Surpanakha
characters.identity_seed: Ravana's sister whose encounter with Rama, Sita and Lakshmana precipitates the chain leading to Sita's abduction
characters.visual_seed: rakshasa woman with strong transformation/performance range; forest-to-Lanka continuity

characters.name: Maricha
characters.identity_seed: Rakshasa compelled by Ravana into the deception involving the golden deer
characters.visual_seed: elder rakshasa; deceptive transformation state; golden-deer manifestation as separate controlled form

characters.name: Jatayu
characters.identity_seed: Aged bird king and friend of Dasharatha who confronts Ravana
characters.visual_seed: majestic aged giant eagle; weathered feathers; heroic flight/combat anatomy

characters.name: Angad
characters.identity_seed: Son of Vali and Tara; prince of Kishkindha; member of the Sita-search and Lanka mission
characters.visual_seed: young powerful vanara prince; lineage cues from Vali and Tara

characters.name: Jambavan
characters.identity_seed: Ancient elder who helps awaken Hanuman's awareness of his strength
characters.visual_seed: elder bear-like warrior; massive but wise; weathered ceremonial presence

characters.name: Tara
characters.identity_seed: Queen associated with Vali and later Sugriva; politically perceptive adviser
characters.visual_seed: regal vanara woman; intelligent expressive face; queenly ornaments

characters.name: Nala
characters.identity_seed: Vanara engineer associated with construction of the bridge to Lanka
characters.visual_seed: athletic builder-warrior; engineering tools integrated into mythic setting

characters.name: Vishwamitra
characters.primary_role: mentor; initiator of Rama's early heroic journey
characters.identity_seed: Sage who takes Rama and Lakshmana to protect his sacrifice and leads them toward Mithila
characters.visual_seed: powerful ascetic sage; royal-warrior past reflected subtly in bearing; staff and austerity

characters.name: Vashishtha
characters.identity_seed: Sage and spiritual adviser to Dasharatha and the Ayodhya royal family
characters.visual_seed: elder Brahmarishi; serene authority; ascetic robes and ritual objects

characters.name: Ahalya
characters.identity_seed: Associated with Gautama's hermitage and Rama's encounter during the journey to Mithila
characters.visual_seed: serene ascetic-household identity; transformation from curse-state to restored presence

characters.name: Guha
characters.identity_seed: Nishada leader and friend of Rama during the departure into exile
characters.visual_seed: riverine warrior-chief; practical forest attire; boatman/archer identity

characters.name: Sumantra
characters.identity_seed: Trusted servant of Dasharatha who accompanies Rama at the beginning of exile
characters.visual_seed: experienced royal charioteer; mature court attire; grounded practical demeanor

characters.name: Sampati
characters.identity_seed: Elder brother of Jatayu who provides the search party with crucial information about Sita's location
characters.visual_seed: aged giant eagle; damaged/aged wings; high-cliff silhouette

characters.name: Nila
characters.identity_seed: Prominent vanara commander in the Lanka campaign
characters.visual_seed: battle-ready vanara commander; distinctive markings/armor family; avoid duplication with Nala

characters.name: Parashurama
characters.identity_seed: Powerful warrior-sage who confronts Rama after the breaking of Shiva's bow
characters.visual_seed: ascetic warrior; axe identity; intense but controlled divine authority

characters.name: Tataka
characters.identity_seed: Rakshasa encountered by Rama during Vishwamitra's protection mission
characters.visual_seed: formidable forest rakshasa; transformation/performance state; non-generic monster design

characters.name: Akampana
characters.identity_seed: Ravana-associated rakshasa who carries intelligence and participates in the escalation toward conflict
characters.visual_seed: Lanka court rakshasa; messenger/counsellor visual language

characters.name: Trijata
characters.primary_role: Sita's compassionate attendant and dream/interpreter figure
characters.identity_seed: Rakshasi associated with Sita in Ashoka grove and a sympathetic voice within Lanka
characters.visual_seed: elder/experienced rakshasi; restrained compassionate performance; Ashoka-grove continuity

characters.name: Sarama
characters.identity_seed: Figure in the Lanka narrative associated with support and information for Sita
characters.visual_seed: Lanka rakshasi with calm sympathetic presence; visually distinct from Trijata

characters.name: Sunaina
characters.identity_seed: Queen of Mithila and mother of Sita in the traditional family account
characters.visual_seed: Mithila royal matriarch; elegant, composed, maternal
